change.summary: Make the JEM Halloween and Christmas atmospheres automatic annual client-local seasons owned by JEM Holidays.

modifiers.before: Halloween presentation requires a manually selected resource pack.
modifiers.after: The local client enables Halloween from October 30 through November 2 inclusive and returns to normal on November 3 every year.

modifiers.before: The Jalloween pack has no calendar owner.
modifiers.after: JEM Holidays ensures JEM Release is active as the base, places Jalloween above it and places the separately installed Halloween GUI above Jalloween. On November 3 it removes seasonal additions, restores previously selected seasonal packs near their saved neighbors and preserves JEM Release plus unrelated changes.

modifiers.before: Minecraft menu and world music remain native.
modifiers.after: JEM Holidays owns the approved AudioYT menu and world playlists during the seasonal window, suppresses only ordinary background music and yields audibly to records without interrupting them.

modifiers.before: JEM Holidays rendered full-bright jack-o-lanterns above selected humanoid mobs during the Halloween window.
modifiers.after: JEM Holidays adds no mob head decoration. Seasonal menu, resource-pack, calendar and music behavior remain independent from entity rendering.

modifiers.before: The managed client has no automatic JEM Christmas presentation.
modifiers.after: From November 28 through January 28 inclusive, JEM Holidays selects JEM Release as the base and JEM Christmas above it. JEM Christmas combines the supplied winter, Christmas, Santa-hat, GUI, hotbar and background-music assets. FancyMenu uses the supplied winter landscape, transparent MINECRAFT JEM EDITION title, snowfall and Christmas string lights. January 29 restores only the managed seasonal selection.

rationale.purpose: Apply reversible annual Halloween and Christmas presentation in the main menu, singleplayer and multiplayer while limiting server time authority to Halloween.
rationale.decision_source: User schedule and JEM Holidays architecture requests on 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-28

introduced.summary: Add the standalone annual Halloween presentation owner.

history.summary: Enable JEM Christmas from November 28 through January 28, compose the supplied redistributable seasonal packs above JEM Release and add the supplied FancyMenu background and transparent title.
Build JEM Holidays 1.0.7 from the current develop owner for the Major Update 4 production release without restoring the rejected mob pumpkin renderer.
Add the standalone annual Halloween presentation owner.
Correct seasonal pack precedence and restoration, enable the installed Halloween GUI above Jalloween, and disable unreliable AudioYT streaming.
Render proportional full-bright vanilla jack-o-lanterns on the requested humanoid seasonal mobs while excluding players, creepers and other non-humanoid mobs.

Ensure every AutoModpack client activates JEM Release below JEM Jalloween during the seasonal window so the approved base presentation and Quick Skin placement are available without manual pack selection.
Remove the rejected JEM-owned pumpkin renderer from all mobs without changing the remaining Halloween presentation.

notes: The seasonal controller is client-only and uses the operating-system local date and timezone.
During Halloween the selected-pack order keeps JEM Release below JEM Jalloween, matching the user-approved test jem stack.
During Christmas the selected-pack order keeps JEM Release below JEM Christmas from November 28 through January 28 inclusive.
Christmas uses the bundled resource-pack music and does not activate the Halloween AudioYT playlist or server midnight authority.
ChristmasChestAllYear remains excluded because its bundled license prohibits redistribution without creator permission.
No biome, world, server or gameplay state is modified.
The YouTube recordings are not bundled or downloaded by JEM Holidays.
JEM Holidays no longer registers an entity renderer or adds pumpkin decorations to mobs.
unresolved: The corrected calendar, resource-pack transition and AudioYT coexistence remain pending player acceptance because Codex did not launch the client.
